text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I exist here for the sake of love. To 
dedicate body and soul to the supreme 
race—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I'll leave the rest to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
